released_detector_semantics.buyer_order: per mint sort by buyer_rank then blockTime and retain first 10
released_detector_semantics.pair_count: all unique wallet pairs inside retained buyers; each mint increments each pair once
released_detector_semantics.launch_hit_for_component: at least two component wallets present in the mint's retained buyers

archive_inventory_finding.implication: full causal replay across all launches cannot be reconstructed from the released zip alone because the detector input pumpfun_buyers.jsonl is not deposited; chain reconstruction or an independently archived first-buyer corpus is required

point_in_time_rule.conservative_effective_time: after the complete first-10 buyer evidence for the third distinct cooccurring launch is knowable

next_experiment.name: RED_COMPACT_PAIR_CAUSAL_REPLAY_v1
next_experiment.method: select deterministic wallet pairs with at least 4 compact intra-launch cooccurrences, reconstruct row wallet-to-signature mappings and blockTimes for the first three cooccurring launches, freeze pair qualification after the third launch, and reserve only strictly subsequent launches for economic testing
next_experiment.why_pair_first: pair qualification is the detector's primitive causal event and avoids retrospectively assigning future union-find component membership
